notes:
Initial inbound from indie devs (micro-startup). Self-serve signup via /signup on 2026-02-18, applied free credits. No AE outreach yet — PLG motion.

Key snippets from sign-up form and micro-interviews: 
- 'We ship a small pair-programming tool and want fast code completions, embeddings for fuzzy search, and a lightweight chat assistant in-app.'
- Founder: Samir (CTO/sole dev) - prefers minimal infra ops, cost-sensitive.
- Latency expectation: <200ms tail for short chat flows; more tolerant for embeddings indexing jobs.
- Working prototype uses OSS LLMs locally but wants hosted API for reliability and simpler billing.

Quote from quick support reply: 'Love the latency — good enough for early users. If we grow we may need reserved capacity but for now hosted API looks ideal.'
